ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   B. anaa bi-khayr
   C. sabaahu l-khayr
   D. marhaban

2. What does the Arabic word أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am well
   B. good morning (the reply)
   C. I
   D. welcome

3. What does the Arabic sentence الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The lamp is above the table.
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. The cat is under the bed.
   D. The pen is in the bag.

4. How is the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. khizaana
   B. taawila
   C. qitta
   D. miftaah

5. What does the Arabic word فِي (fii) mean? (1 mark)
   A. above
   B. under
   C. behind
   D. in

6. What does the Arabic word الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. day
   C. Sunday
   D. Monday

7. What does the Arabic word رَقْصٌ (raqs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. please, go ahead
   B. no
   C. yes
   D. dance

8. Which Arabic sentence means "Do you like bananas?" (1 mark)
   A. هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟
   B. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ
   C. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   D. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ

9. What does the Arabic sentence أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I write with my hand.
   B. I hear with my ear.
   C. I smell with my nose.
   D. I see with my eye.

10. What does the Arabic word قَلْبٌ (qalb) mean? (1 mark)
   A. heart
   B. stomach
   C. finger
   D. face

11. Which mark gives the short vowel 'i'? (1 mark)
   A. kasra, a small line below the letter
   B. Damma, a curl above the letter
   C. shadda
   D. fatHa, a line above the letter

12. In which direction is Arabic read? (1 mark)
   A. From left to right
   B. From the middle
   C. From top to bottom only
   D. From right to left

13. What do the two little strokes at the end of شُكْرًا (shukran) create? (1 mark)
   A. The sound -in
   B. A long ii
   C. The sound -an
   D. The sound -un

14. Which pair of syllables makes the word ukhtun (sister)? (1 mark)
   A. khu + ta
   B. bin + tun
   C. ukh + tun
   D. tun + a

15. Which Arabic sentence means "My sister is beautiful." (1 mark)
   A. مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ
   B. أَخِي صَغِيرٌ
   C. أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   D. جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ

16. What does the Arabic word سَرِيرٌ (sariir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. book
   B. bed
   C. house
   D. door

17. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my room.
   B. On the table there is a cup.
   C. The house is big.
   D. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

18. What does the Arabic sentence أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I read a book on Sunday.
   B. I write with my hand.
   C. I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   D. I help my mother on Saturday.

19. How is the Arabic word أَمْسِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. amsi
   B. al-jumuʿa
   C. al-ithnayn
   D. al-yawm

20. Which sentence means 'I visit my grandmother on Friday'? (1 mark)
   A. azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   B. usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt
   C. aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad
   D. alʿabu yawma s-sabt

21. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The friends are at the party.
   B. This is a party.
   C. On the table there is a cake.
   D. Above the table there is a balloon.

22. How is the Arabic word شَمْعَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. hadiyya
   B. sharaab
   C. dawrii
   D. shamʿa

23. What does the little word li- mean in li-Aminata? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. and
   C. for
   D. on

24. How is the Arabic word مَوْزٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sukkar
   B. milh
   C. mawz
   D. samak

25. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water is useful (good for you).
   B. I like food.
   C. The juice is cold.
   D. The fish is delicious.

26. How is the Arabic word لِسَانٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. fam
   B. lisaan
   C. batn
   D. raqaba

27. How is the Arabic word كَتِفٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shaʿr
   B. raʾs
   C. katif
   D. sinn

28. When reciting a poem, what should your actions do? (1 mark)
   A. Show something different from the words
   B. Match the meaning of the words
   C. Copy a friend's actions
   D. Hide the words

29. How is the Arabic word مَطَرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. riih
   B. nahr
   C. shams
   D. matar

30. Which Arabic word means "behind"? (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى
   B. خَلْفَ
   C. أَمَامَ
   D. بِجَانِبِ

31. What is the name of the Arabic letter ر? (1 mark)
   A. raa
   B. nuun
   C. baa
   D. yaa

32. What does the Arabic word ابْنٌ (ibn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. grandmother
   B. brother
   C. sister
   D. son

33. What does the Arabic sentence النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The chair is new.
   B. The table is small.
   C. The door is big.
   D. The window is clean.

34. Which day has the letter jiim in its name? (1 mark)
   A. as-sabt
   B. al-jumuʿa
   C. al-ahad
   D. al-khamiis

35. Which Arabic writing style is used in most printed books and newspapers? (1 mark)
   A. Naskh
   B. Diwani
   C. Thuluth
   D. Kufic

36. Which Arabic word means "party"? (1 mark)
   A. حَفْلَةٌ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. شَمْعَةٌ
   D. أُغْنِيَةٌ

37. Which Arabic word means "fish"? (1 mark)
   A. بُرْتُقَالٌ
   B. بَيْضٌ
   C. سَمَكٌ
   D. خُضَارٌ

38. What is a stanza? (1 mark)
   A. A spelling test
   B. A kind of word
   C. A group of lines in a poem
   D. A drawing

39. What does the Arabic sentence الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is strong.
   B. This is the sun.
   C. The sun is hot.
   D. This is rain.

40. What does fii l-matbakhi taawila mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table.
   C. The table is small.
   D. I like the kitchen.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: asmaʿu bi-udhunii (2 marks)

42. Write a three-sentence paragraph about your room in Arabic sounds and give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)

43. Translate into English: as-samaku ladhiidh (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidha (2 marks)

45. Translate into English: lii ʿaynaani (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: aakulu l-khubza (2 marks)

47. Write four Arabic celebration words in English letters with their meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

48. Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Describe three steps of making a weather poster. (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidh (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a (2 marks)

52. Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin (2 marks)

53. Give two reasons why we should take care of household items. (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

55. Write the seven days of the week in Arabic sounds, in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

56. Translate into English: maa ismuki? (2 marks)

57. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

58. Describe the steps of making a class picture book on family celebrations. (4 marks) (4 marks)

59. Write an Arabic question and its answer that you could use to find out who a woman in a photograph is. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: hal ʿindaka hafla? (2 marks)

61. Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Explain the three reading strategies: decoding, cues and word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — sabaahu l-khayr
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ is read sabaahu l-khayr and means good morning.

2. D — welcome
   أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) means welcome.

3. D — The pen is in the bag.
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

4. A — khizaana
   خِزَانَةٌ is read khizaana and means cupboard.

5. D — in
   فِي (fii) means in.

6. A — today
   الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) means today.

7. D — dance
   رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

8. A — هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟
   هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

9. A — I write with my hand.
   أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

10. A — heart
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

11. A — kasra, a small line below the letter
   kasra is written below the letter and gives the vowel i.

12. D — From right to left
   Arabic is read from right to left.

13. C — The sound -an
   The double fatHa (tanwiin) gives the sound -an at the end of the word.

14. C — ukh + tun
   ukh-tun is the word for sister.

15. C — أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

16. B — bed
   سَرِيرٌ (sariir) means bed.

17. D — In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ (fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii) means: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

18. A — I read a book on Sunday.
   أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ (aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad) means: I read a book on Sunday.

19. A — amsi
   أَمْسِ is read amsi and means yesterday.

20. A — azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   azuuru means I visit and jaddatii means my grandmother.

21. B — This is a party.
   هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

22. D — shamʿa
   شَمْعَةٌ is read shamʿa and means candle.

23. C — for
   li- means 'for', so li-Aminata is 'for Amina'.

24. C — mawz
   مَوْزٌ is read mawz and means bananas.

25. B — I like food.
   أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

26. B — lisaan
   لِسَانٌ is read lisaan and means tongue.

27. C — katif
   كَتِفٌ is read katif and means shoulder.

28. B — Match the meaning of the words
   Actions must match the words to help the audience understand.

29. D — matar
   مَطَرٌ is read matar and means rain.

30. B — خَلْفَ
   خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

31. A — raa
   The letter ر is called raa.

32. D — son
   ابْنٌ (ibn) means son.

33. D — The window is clean.
   النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ (an-naafidhatu nadhiifa) means: The window is clean.

34. B — al-jumuʿa
   الجمعة contains jiim (ج).

35. A — Naskh
   Naskh is clear and round and is used for most printed books.

36. A — حَفْلَةٌ
   حَفْلَةٌ (hafla) means party.

37. C — سَمَكٌ
   سَمَكٌ (samak) means fish.

38. C — A group of lines in a poem
   A stanza is like a paragraph in a poem.

39. A — The wind is strong.
   الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

40. B — In the kitchen there is a table.
   fii l-matbakhi means in the kitchen and taawila means a table.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: I hear with my ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: haadhihi ghurfatii. fii l-ghurfati sariir. uhibbu ghurfatii. This is my room. In the room there is a bed. I like my room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence, 1 mark for a beginning-middle-end order and 1 mark for the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: The fish is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (girl).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: I eat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw and colour the sun, clouds, rain and wind; write the Arabic word under each; add a sentence and a title and display it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (boy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: How beautiful the environment is!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not play with the knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: They last longer and save money, and keeping them in the right place keeps us safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven in order; 3 for five or six; 2 for three or four; 1 for one or two.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: What is your name? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Collect or draw pictures of celebration things; put one on each page; write an Arabic word or sentence with the meaning; make a cover with a title.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: man haadhihi? haadhihi ummii. (Who is this? This is my mother.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer, 1 mark for correct use of haadhihi for a woman.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: Decoding: sounding out each letter and mark. Cues: using pictures and the sentence to guess. Word spacing: looking at the spaces to see where words begin and end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy.
